HADESANCIENTS-BROKEN_RESOLVE.title: Broken Resolve
HADESANCIENTS-BROKEN_RESOLVE.description: [gold]Weak[/gold] effectiveness is doubled, up to a maximum of [blue]50%[/blue].
HADESANCIENTS-BROKEN_RESOLVE.flavor: "Try as I might, I just can't help but feel the sting of being spurned. And I don't like it, not a little bit. So now I have to sting you back!"
HADESANCIENTS-DIFFERENT_LEAGUE.title: Different League
HADESANCIENTS-DIFFERENT_LEAGUE.descripti: You take [blue]{LessDamage}[/blue] less damage from enemy attacks.
HADESANCIENTS-DIFFERENT_LEAGUE.flavor: "We're just two lovely goddesses together having a night out!"
HADESANCIENTS-FLUTTER_FLOURISH.title: Flutter Flourish
HADESANCIENTS-FLUTTER_FLOURISH.descripti: Every [blue]4th[/blue] Skill you play from your [gold]Hand[/gold] is free.
HADESANCIENTS-FLUTTER_FLOURISH.flavor: "The more distracted you can make them, the easier they are to kill!"
HADESANCIENTS-GLAMOUR_GAIN.title: Glamour Gain
HADESANCIENTS-GLAMOUR_GAIN.description: The first time each turn you apply a debuff to an enemy, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
HADESANCIENTS-GLAMOUR_GAIN.flavor: "Why, you look positively stunning in all that silver light!"
HADESANCIENTS-HEALTHY_REBOUND.title: Healthy Rebound
HADESANCIENTS-HEALTHY_REBOUND.descriptio: At the start of each Normal/Elite/Boss combat, heal [blue]{NormalCombatHeal}[/blue]/[blue]{EliteCombatHeal}[/blue]/[blue]{BossCombatHeal}[/blue] HP.
HADESANCIENTS-HEALTHY_REBOUND.flavor: "Though don't despair! Your heart yet beats, doesn't it?"
HADESANCIENTS-HEARTBREAK_STRIKE.title: Heartbreak Strike
HADESANCIENTS-HEARTBREAK_STRIKE.descript: Your Attacks deal [blue]{MoreDamagePercent}%[/blue] more damage for each [gold]Weak[/gold] on the enemy and apply [blue]{WeakPower}[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] on every hit.
HADESANCIENTS-HEARTBREAK_STRIKE.flavor: "At this rate, you'll end up breaking more hearts than me!"
HADESANCIENTS-NERVOUS_WRECK.title: Nervous Wreck
HADESANCIENTS-NERVOUS_WRECK.description: Whenever you apply debuffs on enemies, apply twice as much.
HADESANCIENTS-NERVOUS_WRECK.flavor: "Our emotions ran a little hot there, didn't they... I still can feel my heart racing, and if I'm not mistaken, yours might have been, too!"
HADESANCIENTS-SHAMELESS_ATTITUDE.title: Shameless Attitude
HADESANCIENTS-SHAMELESS_ATTITUDE.descrip: Your Attacks deal [blue]33.(3)%[/blue] more damage. If you have [blue]50%[/blue] HP or more, your Attacks deal [blue]66.(6)%[/blue] more damage instead.
HADESANCIENTS-SHAMELESS_ATTITUDE.flavor: "Oh, gorgeous. If pride and vanity are truly weaknesses, then I'm about to let myself be very vulnerable with you here..."
HADESANCIENTS-SISYPHUS_AID.title: Sisyphus' Aid
HADESANCIENTS-SISYPHUS_AID.description: At the start of each combat, [gold]Rolling Boulder[/gold] is played for free.
HADESANCIENTS-SISYPHUS_AID.flavor: "Bouldy says whatever we can do to help, we'll do it!"
HADESANCIENTS-SPIRITUAL_AFFIRMATION.desc: Upon pickup, gain [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] Max HP and [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
HADESANCIENTS-SPIRITUAL_AFFIRMATION.flav: "As long as you have love in your heart, you'll probably be fine!"
HADESANCIENTS-SWEET_NECTAR.title: Sweet Nectar
HADESANCIENTS-SWEET_NECTAR.description: Whenever you [gold]Smith[/gold] at a Rest Site, upgrade [blue]{Cards}[/blue] other random cards.
HADESANCIENTS-SWEET_SURRENDER.title: Sweet Surrender
HADESANCIENTS-SWEET_SURRENDER.descriptio: Whenever you apply [gold]Weak[/gold], apply the same amount of [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and [gold]Charm[/gold].
HADESANCIENTS-SWEET_SURRENDER.flavor: "Between us goddesses, may you kill everybody standing in your way!"
